import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.optimize import minimize
# Amidophosphine dichlorogermyl chelate, with P -> Ir coordination.
s='CC(C)c1cccc(C(C)C)c1N1P(c2ccccc2)(c2ccccc2)->[Ir](Cl)[Ge]1(Cl)Cl'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetSymbol()=='P': a.SetNoImplicit(True)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('chelate atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetSymbol() in ['N','P','Ge','Ir','Cl']:print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),'Hs',a.GetTotalNumHs(),'rad',a.GetNumRadicalElectrons())
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=68,useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
# core idealized four-membered metallacycle
core={12:np.array([0.,0.,0.]),13:np.array([1.73,0.,0.]),28:np.array([-.125,-1.906,0.]),26:np.array([2.27,-2.20,0.])}
x=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
# rigidly align original core against target
inds=[12,13,28,26]; A=x[inds];B=np.array([core[i] for i in inds]);ac=A.mean(0);bc=B.mean(0)
u,ss,vh=np.linalg.svd((A-ac).T@(B-bc));R=u@vh
if np.linalg.det(R)<0:u[:,-1]*=-1;R=u@vh
x=(x-ac)@R+bc
# impose core and its initial Cl positions
for i,p in core.items():x[i]=p
x[27]=core[26]+np.array([-.20,-.35,2.31])
x[29]=core[28]+2.15*np.array([-.467,-.390,.794])
x[30]=core[28]+2.15*np.array([-.467,-.390,-.794])
for i,p in enumerate(x):m.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,p)
ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
for i in core:ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
for i in [27,29,30]:ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
ff.Initialize();ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000)
x=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
# Cp* aromatic anion, all five methyl substituents.
cp=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('C[c-]1c(C)c(C)c(C)c1C'))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(cp,randomSeed=680)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(cp,maxIters=1000)
cpx=np.array(cp.GetConformer().GetPositions())
ring=[a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.IsInRing()]
print('cp',cp.GetNumAtoms(),ring)
# aim ring centroid opposite the three piano-stool legs.
ir=x[26]; up=(x[13]-ir)/np.linalg.norm(x[13]-ir);ug=(x[28]-ir)/np.linalg.norm(x[28]-ir); uc=(x[27]-ir)/np.linalg.norm(x[27]-ir)
axis=np.cross(up-ug,uc-ug);axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
if np.dot(axis,up)>0:axis=-axis
cent=ir+1.82*axis
# frame and place Cp; retain proper handedness.
rc=cpx[ring].mean(0);_,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(cpx[ring]-rc);normal=vh[-1];e1=(cpx[ring[0]]-rc);e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1);e2=np.cross(normal,e1);e2/=np.linalg.norm(e2);normal=np.cross(e1,e2)
new1=np.cross(axis,[0,0,1]);new1/=np.linalg.norm(new1);new2=np.cross(axis,new1)
coords=(cpx-rc)@np.array([e1,e2,normal]).T
best=None
for phi in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,36,endpoint=False):
 a=new1*np.cos(phi)+new2*np.sin(phi);b=-new1*np.sin(phi)+new2*np.cos(phi)
 pos=coords@np.array([a,b,axis])+cent
 d=np.linalg.norm(x[:,None,:]-pos[None,:,:],axis=-1)
 # mild contact score avoiding metals having no vdW parameters
 radii={'C':1.70,'H':1.20,'N':1.55,'P':1.80,'Ge':2.0,'Cl':1.75,'Ir':0.0}
 r1=np.array([radii[a.GetSymbol()] for a in m.GetAtoms()]);r2=np.array([radii[a.GetSymbol()] for a in cp.GetAtoms()]); lim=.85*(r1[:,None]+r2[None,:]); lim[26]=0
 score=np.sum(np.maximum(lim-d,0)**2)
 if best is None or score<best[0]:best=(score,pos)
print('cp best clash score',best[0], 'axis',axis)
# join fragments, retain covalent/dative ligand bonds; Cp metal distances applied explicitly below
mol=Chem.CombineMols(m,cp); xx=np.vstack([x,best[1]]); n=len(x)
for i,p in enumerate(xx):mol.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,p)
ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol,ignoreInterfragInteractions=False)
# fix metallacycle and terminal metal chloride; relax everything else including the Cp* azimuth
for i in list(core)+[27]:ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
# Cp-metal five-fold hapticity; a center 1.82 A over the pi system corresponds to Ir-C ~2.20 A.
for j in ring:ff.UFFAddDistanceConstraint(26,n+j,False,2.195,2.195,600.)
# retain Ge chloride wedge stereochemistry, while permitting small metric changes
for j in [29,30]:ff.UFFAddPositionConstraint(j,.12,200.)
ff.Initialize();print('energy initial',ff.CalcEnergy());res=ff.Minimize(maxIts=4000);print('energy final',ff.CalcEnergy(),res)
xx=np.array(mol.GetConformer().GetPositions())
np.save('initial_coords.npy',xx)
Chem.MolToMolFile(mol,'structure.mol')
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(xx)}\nCp*IrCl chelated by DippN(PPh2)GeCl2; coordinates in angstrom\n')
 for a,p in zip(mol.GetAtoms(),xx):f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p[0]: .8f} {p[1]: .8f} {p[2]: .8f}\n')
print('atoms',len(xx))
